definition: A form used by U.S. citizens and resident aliens to calculate this document exclusion and housing exclusion or deduction when living and working abroad, provided they meet the tax home test and either the bona fide residence test or physical presence test.

includes.text: Contains sections for reporting this document from wages, salaries, professional fees, and other compensation for personal services performed in a foreign country
Includes calculation of housing exclusion or deduction for reasonable expenses paid for foreign housing of the taxpayer, spouse, and dependents
Requires documentation of the 12-month period used to establish physical presence in a foreign country
